description: Capricorn decan 2 (January 1 to January 9): personality, love, work and growth, with Venus as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Capricorn.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Capricorn covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly January 1 to January 9, with Venus as its sub-ruler beside Saturn. It is read as ambition polished with taste, sensuality and a builder's patience. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Capricorn decan 2 personality
paragraphs: Between 10 and 19 degrees, Capricorn borrows Venus as its sub-ruler, the planet that governs Taurus. Saturn's sign meeting Venus's influence gives this decan an earthy elegance. Natives are often described as steady, practical and appreciative of quality, the sort of person who would rather own one well-made coat than ten fashionable ones. They tend to value comfort, beauty and stability, and they work patiently to build lives that offer all three. Ambition remains strong, but it is softened by a love of pleasure and a recognition that a good life is meant to be enjoyed, not merely achieved.

Venus brings charm and sociability to a sign that can otherwise seem reserved. These Capricorns often understand that relationships, taste and reputation are assets, and they cultivate them carefully. They may have a talent for business that involves aesthetics, from property to design to fine food. The shadow side can be stubbornness or an attachment to material comfort that makes change feel risky. Possessiveness may appear when they feel uncertain. Yet the blend is unusually grounded. Saturn provides structure and staying power, while Venus adds warmth and appreciation, producing people who build lasting things and take real pleasure in tending them.

sections.heading: Capricorn decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, Venus's decan of Capricorn tends to be devoted, sensual and quietly romantic. Commitment matters, and they often show affection through stability: a comfortable home, thoughtful gifts, reliability in difficult moments. Physical comfort and shared rituals, such as a regular dinner together, carry a lot of meaning. They usually prefer partners who are loyal and who share their appreciation for the finer, simpler things. Change in a relationship can unsettle them. Being willing to talk about feelings, not just to provide practical care, helps their partners feel fully seen and lets the relationship evolve with grace over time.

At work, this decan often thrives where practicality meets aesthetics: architecture, interior design, property, banking, luxury goods, hospitality, food production, arts management and craft. They tend to have an eye for value and the patience to let quality emerge. Colleagues find them dependable and pleasant to work with, and clients often trust them. They may resist rapid change or risk. Balancing their preference for stability with a willingness to experiment occasionally can open doors. Their combination of good taste and persistence is often the quiet engine behind projects that endure for years.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Capricorn decan 2: what Venus adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Capricorn, which in most years means birthdays from January 1 to January 9. Its sub-ruler, Venus, comes from Taurus, the next earth sign after Capricorn, so this decan borrows a little of Taurus's character while staying Capricorn at heart. The other two decans of Capricorn belong to Saturn (decan 1) and Mercury (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Venus contributes charm, taste and a pull towards harmony. Its decans tend to be pictured as more sociable and aesthetic, alert to beauty and fairness, and keen to soften conflict through diplomacy, pleasure and good company. Venusian decans are often linked with art, hospitality, partnership and style, and their usual lesson is to say what they want rather than smooth it over. Set against Capricorn's ambition, discipline, patience and dry, steady resilience, that Venus note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Capricorn decan 2
paragraphs: Growth for second-decan Capricorn often involves loosening attachment to comfort and certainty. One practical step is introducing small, low-stakes changes to routine, which can make larger transitions feel less threatening. Another is examining whether a possession or habit still brings joy or merely feels safe to keep. Expressing affection in words, not only in practical gestures, tends to deepen relationships. Time spent in nature, cooking or making something with their hands is traditionally restorative for Venus-earth temperaments. Their steadiness is a gift. Paired with flexibility, it becomes a resilient kind of comfort that can adapt rather than simply endure.

Within Capricorn, decan 1 leans towards discipline, patience and long-range ambition in their most classic form and decan 3 leans towards strategic intelligence with an analyst's eye for detail. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is Venus the sub-ruler of Capricorn's second decan?
faq.answer: In the triplicity system the middle decan takes the ruler of the next sign in the same element. The earth signs run Capricorn, Taurus, Virgo, and Taurus is governed by Venus. That gives this decan a taste for beauty, comfort and enduring quality.

faq.question: What are the dates of Capricorn decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years January 1 to January 9, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Capricorn. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Capricorn decan 2?
faq.answer: Venus. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Capricorn's own ruler, Saturn.
